description: V4 split definitions. Single source of truth for all downstream scripts.

split_logic.oov_unseen_pos: Human-verified events from OOV positive classes
split_logic.oov_unseen_neg: Balanced sample from OOV negative classes (matching OOV pos count)
split_logic.test_seen_neg: Balanced sample from non-OOV negative classes (matching test pos count)
split_logic.train: Everything else (excluding non-verified OOV positive locations)
split_logic.geo_holdout: Orthogonal tag on test/OOV locations within geo boxes. Train locations in boxes are excluded.
